evidence_tree.restriction_honored: No src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, diff, or git history was read. Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md from the export.

question_restated: Is it correct for the syndra_derived_order_60 rotation to carry a seventh provenance source -- a self_state option named r_spheres attributed to slot R -- rather than no such source at all?

step_1_read_cached_R_text.quote: Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.
step_1_read_cached_R_text.deduction: Sphere count N used by Unleashed Power has domain N in [3, 7] (3 conjured + 0..4 collected). The damage is per-sphere and paid N times.

algebraic_check: 3 x per-sphere: 3x80=240, 3x120=360, 3x160=480 ; 3x20% = 60% AP  == Minimum row exactly, all three ranks, base and ratio
7 x per-sphere: 7x80=560, 7x120=840, 7x160=1120 ; 7x20% = 140% AP == Maximum row exactly, all three ranks, base and ratio
step_2_cached_leveling_rows.conclusion: The wiki's own Minimum/Maximum rows are the N=3 and N=7 evaluations of the same per-sphere row. So the cached data itself encodes N as a FREE PARAMETER of R with domain [3,7]; it does not fix a value.

worked_example_rank_3_AP_500.spread: 7/3 = 2.333x -- the R contribution is undetermined by a factor of 2.33 until N is supplied

step_3_R_total_formula.implication: A rotation that casts R produces a numerically undetermined total unless N is supplied by an explicit input. That input must therefore appear in the rotation's source/provenance list. Its absence (old value) is a provenance hole on a 2.33x-wide term.

step_4_why_N_must_be_an_OPTION_and_not_d.why_this_matters: The scenario id contains 'derived_order' -- if the engine could derive N from the derived cast order (e.g. count of Q casts still alive at R time), an explicit option would be redundant. The cached wiki notes rule that out.
quotes: Depending on how many spheres are on the map and how far away the enemy is upon casting Unleashed Power it is possible that Syndra would conjure the sphere behind her as if she was going to throw it, but she won't.
Unleashed Power will not add a Sphere that Syndra is holding with Force of Will.
Spheres that are being pushed by Scatter the Weak (normally ones that were made late during the push) will not get picked up for Unleashed Power.
A sphere summoned very shortly before Unleashed Power will be used as one of the spheres that get thrown.
step_4_why_N_must_be_an_OPTION_and_not_d.conclusion: The number of spheres actually collected depends on map position, distance to target, whether a sphere is currently held by W, and whether spheres are mid-flight from E -- none of which a cast-order derivation determines. N is genuinely a player-declared field state, i.e. a self_state option, not a derivable quantity.

step_5_kind_and_slot_attribution.kind_self_state: N counts Syndra's OWN spheres on the field (conjured by her Q, per Q text: 'The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds'). It is a property of the caster's board state, not of the target and not of an item -- self_state is the correct kind.
step_5_kind_and_slot_attribution.slot_R: The per-sphere multiplication happens only in Unleashed Power ('barrages the target ... with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage'). Q's own damage is per-cast and does not read N. Attributing the option to slot R is correct.
step_5_kind_and_slot_attribution.ordering: Index 6 (last) is consistent with slot order P, Q, W, E, R -- R-slot inputs sort last.

step_6_scenario_id_60_cross_check.source: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.W ... 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.'
step_6_scenario_id_60_cross_check.reading: The '60' in the scenario id is the Splinters-of-Wrath stack count (P stacks to 120; thresholds at 40 Q-charge, 60 W-true-damage, 80 E-scatter, 100 R-execute, 120 +15% AP).
step_6_scenario_id_60_cross_check.consequence: At 60 splinters the R execute (needs 100) is NOT active, so R's contribution is purely N * per-sphere damage. This makes r_spheres the ONLY input that resolves R's number in this scenario -- it cannot be omitted.

corroborating_cached_audit_records.quote: R reads 'Magic Damage per Sphere' x user-set sphere count.

E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.
corroborating_cached_audit_records.note: Independently names the option 'r_spheres' and ties it to R -- matching the new value's name and slot.
The cached Syndra ability rows used above are current against the game files, so the 80/120/160 per-sphere and 3x/7x min/max rows are trustworthy inputs.

sources_quoted: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.R[0].effects[1].leveling (per-sphere 80/120/160 +20% AP; min 240/360/480 +60% AP; max 560/840/1120 +140% AP)
data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.R[0].notes (position / W-hold / E-push caveats making N non-derivable)
data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q[0] and W[0] (sphere 6s ground duration; 60-splinter W true damage)

docs/math-foundations.md Sec. 1.2 (linearity of expectation for multi-hit abilities: an N-hit ability's expected damage is N x per-hit expectation, so N is a required model input) -- the doc contains no text on source/provenance lists, so it neither supports nor contradicts the leaf's shape; the numeric argument rests on the cached wiki rows.
verdict_rationale: The cached wiki rows prove Unleashed Power's damage is per-sphere x N with N a free parameter in [3,7] (the Minimum and Maximum rows are exactly the N=3 and N=7 evaluations of the per-sphere row at every rank). The R notes prove N is not derivable from cast order -- it depends on positioning, W-held spheres and E-pushed spheres. Therefore a rotation containing an R cast must expose N as an explicit self_state input on slot R, and its provenance list must name it. The new value 'option r_spheres (self_state, slot R)' is exactly that entry, with the same name the cached audit records use. The old value (<absent>) left a term that varies by 2.33x undocumented in the rotation's sources.
caveats: The golden baseline file, the scenario definition and the engine source were not read (runbook restriction), so this receipt validates the SEMANTIC correctness of the added source -- that r_spheres is a real, required, self-state, R-slot input for a Syndra rotation at 60 splinters -- not the literal serialization string or the index-6 position beyond noting that slot order P/Q/W/E/R puts an R input last.
The exact default sphere count chosen by the scenario is not visible from data/; whatever it is, it must lie in [3,7].
